children: SoundHound AI named John Collins as its chief financial officer, overseeing the finances of the newly expanded company, which on Friday completed its acquisition of LivePerson.

In the role, Collins will focus on accelerating SoundHound's path to sustainable profitability, while maintaining its growth trajectory and disciplined approach to capital allocation, the company said.
Collins has more than 15 years of leadership experience, having previously held a variety of roles at LivePerson including finance chief, chief operating officer and interim CEO.

"Joining SoundHound AI at this pivotal juncture is an extraordinary opportunity to help steer the company's next phase of global growth at a time of rapid agentic AI adoption by large enterprises," he said.

Collins appointment came as SoundHound completed its acquisition of LivePerson, a deal the company said will immediately expand its market footprint. The combination brings together SoundHound's proprietary voice agentic AI, with LivePerson's enterprise digital-messaging infrastructure.

The unified company is positioned to target more than $500 million in future revenue from the existing customer base alone, SoundHound said. The company's fully debt-free combined balance sheet establishes a financial foundation for accelerated commercial growth and continuous product innovation, it added.
